# STRIP JACK NAKED + GRAPHICS SEQUENCE - Lindsay R. Ford ('DREAMCARDS') - DREAMER 13 p.15-16
# (PDF pages 17-18).  2K version: main program 0080-03FF as printed (020C = 2400, 03FC = 2404,
# the calls into the add-on) + GRAPHICS SEQUENCE 0400-05A1 (printed "0400 - 0600"; display
# data 04FC-05A1, the article says it can be altered).  Needs a 2K DREAM.  Run C000.
# Play as in strip_jack_naked.txt (any key deals your card); the add-on shows a picture
# sequence (a figure losing clothes) according to the points left, between rounds.
# Corrections: none (printed 2400/2404 are right for this version - errata DREAMER 14).
# The main rows are the same as strip_jack_naked.txt except 020C/03FC.
